user.title: Battery Management
user.description: Pick the household grid-power sensor (+ = import, - = export) and how many battery units to coordinate. You can tune the control parameters later under Configure.

data.bias: Import bias (W) - aim for a small import so you never export
data.deadband: Deadband (W) - ignore errors smaller than this

unit_device.title: Battery unit {index} of {total}: pick the device
unit_device.description: Pick the Anker device for this unit and the next screen is filled in for you - you still get to check it. Leave it empty to select all six entities by hand.

unit.title: Battery unit {index} of {total}
unit.description: Select the Modbus control entities for this Anker SOLIX Max AC unit. The two limit fields are optional and expect a percentage - leave them blank to use 100 % / 5 %.

error.duplicate_name: Another unit already uses this name. Names must be unique, otherwise the two packs are treated as one.
error.duplicate_entity: This entity is already used for another field on this unit. Each field needs its own entity.
error.limit_not_percentage: This looks like a power entity, not a state-of-charge percentage. The limit fields expect a percentage (0-100); leave blank to use 100 % / 5 %.

tuning.title: Tune the coordinator
tuning.description: Saving reloads the integration. The units are briefly handed back to self-consumption, then the coordinator resumes on its own with the setpoint it had.

units.title: Battery unit {index} of {total}: {name}
units.description: Correct the control entities for this unit. The two limit fields expect a percentage - leave them blank to use 100 % / 5 %.

error.duplicate_entity: This entity is already used for another field on this unit. Each field needs its own entity.
error.limit_not_percentage: This looks like a power entity, not a state-of-charge percentage. The limit fields expect a percentage (0-100); leave blank to use 100 % / 5 %.
